reply:
Good afternoon Chidi,

I've looked into transfer TRF-INV-88 for ₦250,000. Although our system shows it as "failed," I verified the final status directly with Access Bank, and their records show the transfer was successful — the funds were credited to account 0234567891 on 21 November 2026 at 14:02 (bank session ID: 000014261121140211000088).

Could you please check your account statement? The ₦250,000 should be there. If you don't see it, kindly contact Access Bank with the session ID above so they can trace the credit on their side.

For now, I won't resend the payment — since the recipient bank confirms the money was credited, resending could result in a duplicate payment. If Access Bank confirms the funds never actually landed in your account, please get back to me and we'll sort it out from there.

Best regards,
Mama's Kitchen Operations

Access Bank's verification confirms the transfer was credited to the recipient account on 21 Nov 2026 (session ID 000014261121140211000088), but the supplier insists the funds are not in his account and is requesting a resend.
